propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena symbol tools despite documentation because grep has zero friction (already in-hand) while Serena symbol tools require an extra ToolSearch discovery round-trip.
Serena cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib patterns), so grep alone is incomplete and Serena alone misses those sites.
The documented preference for symbol tools fails to trigger in-the-moment because it is a standing disposition in AGENTS.md loaded once at session start, not bound to the action of running grep.

Serena's LSP index can lag behind recent edits in the current tree (e.g., reporting stale line numbers from prior commits), while grep reflects the actual current state, making grep necessary for post-edit verification.
No feedback mechanism exists to detect or correct when agents enumerate source references by hand instead of using the preferred symbol tools.

Two independent structural fixes are needed: remove the discovery-step friction by pre-loading Serena symbol tools, and re-surface the tooling choice at the moment of grep invocation via a PreToolUse hook reminder.
